description: Button 1 of the den's SNZB-01M multi button (owner, 2026-11-06) drives the den tall lamp (WiZ bulb, light.den_tall_lamp). Single click switches it off if it is on, and on in the default white, 2700 K at 75 %, if it is not (owner, 2026-11-06: a plain toggle brought it back in whatever colour it was last left in, such as after the colour cycle). Double click steps its brightness through 25, 50, 75 and 100 % and back to 25. Triple click steps its colour through warm white, red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue and purple, and back to warm white. On a lamp that is not on, either one only switches it on in the default white (2700 K at 75 %), because den_tall_lamp_default_white_on_power_on gives every switch-on that white anyway (owner, 2026-11-06); in a colour it picks the next after the nearest hue of those, since the bulb reports hues a few degrees off what was sent. The button is the zha_event's endpoint_id (1 to 4) and the click is its command: single, double, triple or hold (HOME-ASSISTANT.md gotcha 33); the step and stop events the remote also sends are not matched. Button 2 is den_multibutton_sideboard_lamp_restart. Source: tools/ha/automations in the HomeAssistant repo.

then.stop: The lamp was not on, so it came on in the default white

variables.next_brightness: {% set levels = [25, 50, 75, 100] %}{% set current = (state_attr('light.den_tall_lamp', 'brightness') | float(0)) * 100 / 255 %}{{ (levels | select('gt', current + 3) | list + [25]) | first }}

then.stop: The lamp was not on, so it came on in the default white

variables.next_colour: {% set hues = [0, 30, 60, 120, 180, 240, 285] %}{% set lamp = 'light.den_tall_lamp' %}{% if state_attr(lamp, 'color_mode') == 'rgbw' and state_attr(lamp, 'hs_color') %}{% set current = state_attr(lamp, 'hs_color')[0] | float(0) %}{% set nearest = namespace(index=0, distance=999) %}{% for hue in hues %}{% set gap = (current - hue) | abs %}{% set distance = [gap, 360 - gap] | min %}{% if distance < nearest.distance %}{% set nearest.distance = distance %}{% set nearest.index = loop.index0 %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ 'warm' if nearest.index == hues | length - 1 else hues[nearest.index + 1] }}{% else %}{{ hues[0] }}{% endif %}
